connector.name: MCP Server by gatefareio
connector.registryDescription: Marketplace of paid HTTP APIs. USDC micropayments via x402 on Base. Non-custodial.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gatefareio account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: EVM private key (32 bytes hex). Required for buyer tools (call_api, get_wallet_balance, estimate_cost). Stays on the user's machine.

env.name: WALLET_BUDGET_USD
env.description: Optional runtime spend cap in USD; call_api throws BUDGET_EXHAUSTED when reached.

env.name: WALLET_NETWORK
env.description: Network identifier. Defaults to eip155:8453 (Base mainnet). Use eip155:84532 for Sepolia testnet.

env.name: GATEFARE_PAT
env.description: Personal access token (gfpat_...) from gatefare.io/dashboard/tokens. Required for publisher tools (register_api, list_my_apis, update_api, get_revenue, distribute).

env.name: GATEFARE_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Gatefare base URL (defaults to https://gatefare.io). Useful for self-hosted deployments.
